optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Experienced evaluation engineer with a proven track record of owning end‑to‑end evaluation programs for enterprise knowledge base models, maintaining extensive question‑answer sets and scoring scripts, running pre‑release evaluations, coordinating cross‑functional teams, and documenting assumptions and limitations.  Delivered five model releases in a year, publishing detailed reports and influencing ship/no‑ship decisions.  Recognized by product leadership as the gatekeeper for model releases.
experienceHighlights: Maintained 1,900+ QA pairs across four content domains and scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy.
Ran pre‑release evaluations for five model versions, publishing reports with per‑domain breakdowns to the model team and head of product.
Coordinated evaluation‑set changes with model and content teams during fortnightly quality reviews; ship or hold decisions were taken by the head of product based on the report.
Authored evaluation notes for each version, documenting set composition, known limitations (e.g., under‑sampled new domains), and hand‑over items for the next evaluation.
Managed evaluation‑set maintenance, scoring scripts, pre‑release evaluations, and evaluation notes over two years on the knowledge base quality team.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Scoring script repository README and evaluation report for version 4.1, including evaluation run identifiers as a verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and notes establish the candidate’s ownership of the evaluation program, maintenance of evaluation sets and scoring scripts, execution of pre‑release evaluations, coordination with model and content teams, and documentation of assumptions and limitations.  They do not provide evidence of other unrelated responsibilities or broader product management experience.
